task:
RECORD THE OWNER DECISION OF 2026-10-31: OCTOPUS REVIEW IS REQUIRED ONLY FOR PRS THAT TOUCH RISKY PATHS. CODEX REVIEW, CI AND EVERY OTHER SAFEGUARD STAY ON EVERY PR. DOCS, PR TEMPLATE, CLAUDE.md AND CONTRACT TESTS ONLY. NO CODE OR WORKFLOW CHANGES.

Why: Octopus is a paid reviewer (it charges model list price plus a markup). Thirteen reviews overnight on 2026-10-30/31 used the owner's whole top-up. The owner decided on 2026-10-31: "Risky PRs only".

Files to change (and nothing else):
- docs/development/pull-request-acceptance-policy.md
- .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
- CLAUDE.md (only the "## CI and acceptance" section's sentence that says both Codex Review and Octopus Review must satisfy the policy for every PR)
- tests/test_octopus_final_candidate_cadence.py
- tests/test_pull_request_acceptance_policy.py (only the assertions that would otherwise break; keep every other assertion)
Do NOT edit any file under .github/workflows/, apps/, scripts/, sql/, deploy/, or .octopusignore.

1. docs/development/pull-request-acceptance-policy.md
   a. Acceptance gate item 2: Codex Review is required on every PR, against the exact latest head, exactly as now. Octopus Review is required only when the PR is "in Octopus scope" (new section below), and then exactly as now: once, on the final-candidate head. Keep the trigger/await/no-waiver-for-pending wording, scoped to in-scope PRs for Octopus.
   b. Acceptance gate item 5: keep "Any new commit invalidates all prior CI and reviewer evidence for merge eligibility on the new head" verbatim. Reword the rest so that before merge Codex Review must have completed against the exact latest head on every PR, and Octopus Review too when the PR is in Octopus scope. Remove the sentence about the docs-only update-merge exception.
   c. Add a new section directly after "## Acceptance gate", titled exactly: "## Octopus scope (owner decision 2026-10-31)". Content, in plain short sentences:
      - Octopus is paid per review, so it reviews only PRs where a missed defect could damage production data, production hosts, credentials or sign-in.
      - A PR is in Octopus scope when at least one file in its own diff against main (`git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD`) matches any of these, ignoring Markdown (`.md`) files, which never put a PR in scope:
        1. `sql/` — database migrations and SQL.
        2. `.github/workflows/` — CI, deploy and Codex-bridge workflows.
        3. `deploy/` — production and checkpoint deployment.
        4. `scripts/operator/` and `scripts/rehearsal/` — production operator and purge-rehearsal tooling.
        5. any path outside `docs/` whose name contains `purge` (any letter case) — the governed purge.
        6. sign-in, identity and personal data: `apps/api/src/auth.py`, `apps/api/src/routers/auth.py`, `apps/web/src/lib/auth/`, `apps/api/src/edfinder_api/journal/`.
      - Everything else is out of scope, including docs-only PRs, application and planner code, tests, generated API clients and dependency updates. Those PRs still need green protected CI, a completed Codex Review on the exact latest head, the paginated inspection of every review surface, and a recorded disposition for every substantive finding.
      - For an out-of-scope PR, do not request Octopus. Record on the PR, before merge, a comment saying it is out of Octopus scope under the owner decision of 2026-10-31, with the head SHA and the output of the scope check (the changed-file list).
      - Scope is decided on the exact latest head. If a later commit adds an in-scope file, the PR becomes in scope and needs Octopus on its final-candidate head.
      - The owner may request Octopus on any PR, or declare any PR in scope; then the normal Octopus rules apply to it.
      - If Octopus reviews an out-of-scope PR anyway (for example the owner asked, or an automatic review ran), its findings are substantive findings like any other and need a recorded disposition.
   d. Replace the whole "## Docs-only update merges (owner decision 2026-10-30)" section with a short section titled exactly "## Docs-only update merges (superseded 2026-10-31)" saying: the 2026-10-30 rule let a docs-only PR keep an earlier Octopus review across update merges of main; since 2026-10-31 docs-only PRs are out of Octopus scope, so the rule no longer has any use; Codex Review and CI still run on every head. Remove the six numbered conditions.
   e. Keep "## Final-candidate review cadence", "## Reviewer failure and owner waiver" (including the HTTP 429 / out-of-credits paragraph, which now applies to in-scope PRs), "## Auto-merge transition" and "## Findings after merge" otherwise unchanged. In the cadence section add one sentence near the start: "This cadence applies to PRs in Octopus scope." Keep the sentence "a stale octopus review from an earlier sha can never contribute to merge eligibility" (any letter case is fine; tests lowercase the text).

2. .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
   - Add, before the Octopus checkbox: `- [ ] Octopus scope checked (policy "Octopus scope"): in scope / out of scope — changed files that put it in scope: `________``
   - Change the Octopus checkbox to: `- [ ] If in Octopus scope: Octopus Review completed on the final-candidate head — status: `________`; reviewed SHA: `________________________________________``
   - Keep the line "Octopus was not deliberately triggered on intermediate heads that were already expected to change".
   - In the paragraph below the checklist: keep "do not deliberately rerun Octopus during iterative remediation" and "this head is a final candidate" wording; replace "both reviewer reviewed SHAs must equal the exact latest PR head" with "the Codex reviewed SHA, and the Octopus reviewed SHA when the PR is in Octopus scope, must equal the exact latest PR head"; replace the docs-only exception sentence with "PRs outside Octopus scope do not request Octopus (owner decision 2026-10-31)." Keep the link to the canonical policy and the waiver sentence.

3. CLAUDE.md — in "## CI and acceptance", change the sentence beginning "Both Codex Review (`chatgpt-codex-connector`) and Octopus Review must satisfy that policy" so it says Codex Review must satisfy the policy for the exact latest PR head SHA on every PR, and Octopus Review must too when the PR is in the policy's Octopus scope. Keep the rest of that paragraph ("Green CI alone is insufficient" and the dispositions sentence) unchanged. Change nothing else in CLAUDE.md.

4. Tests — update to assert the NEW contract (do not delete coverage):
   tests/test_octopus_final_candidate_cadence.py:
   - keep the final-candidate cadence assertions that still hold;
   - replace the `both reviewer services must have completed against the exact latest head` assertion with assertions on the new item-5 wording (Codex on every PR; Octopus when in scope) and keep the "any new commit invalidates" and "stale octopus review" assertions;
   - replace test_docs_only_update_merge_rule_stays_narrow with test_octopus_scope_is_pinned: the scope heading exists; each of the six path rules appears (`sql/`, `.github/workflows/`, `deploy/`, `scripts/operator/`, `scripts/rehearsal/`, `purge`, `apps/api/src/auth.py`, `apps/api/src/routers/auth.py`, `apps/web/src/lib/auth/`, `apps/api/src/edfinder_api/journal/`); Markdown files never put a PR in scope; out-of-scope PRs still need Codex on the exact latest head and a recorded scope comment; a later in-scope commit brings the PR into scope; the owner may request Octopus on any PR; the docs-only section is marked superseded and its six numbered conditions are gone;
   - update test_pr_template_records_final_candidate_cadence to the new template lines.
   tests/test_pull_request_acceptance_policy.py: adjust only the assertions that break (for example test_canonical_policy_requires_both_reviewers_on_latest_head should now assert Codex on every PR and Octopus for in-scope PRs; test_claude_and_template_link_to_complete_acceptance_policy should still find "octopus review" in CLAUDE.md). Keep all merge-detector and auto-merge tests unchanged.

VALIDATION (CPython 3.14): `python -m ruff check apps tests scripts shared_contracts`; `python -m ruff check apps tests scripts --select B905`; with PYTHONPATH=apps/api/src CORS_ORIGINS=http://test EDDN_SIMULATION_INGEST_ENABLED=false run `python -m pytest -q tests/test_octopus_final_candidate_cadence.py tests/test_pull_request_acceptance_policy.py tests/test_repo_hygiene_contract.py`, then the backend unit suite exactly as CI runs it: `python -m pytest --ignore=tests/integration --ignore=tests/test_deploy_main_invariants_gate.py -m "unit or not (integration or db or operator or e2e or slow)" -q`, and report counts. Also `grep -rn -i "docs-only update merges\|both reviewer" CLAUDE.md .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md docs/development/pull-request-acceptance-policy.md` and show the output so leftovers are visible.

SUMMARY: list every changed file with one line on what changed; paste the full new "## Octopus scope (owner decision 2026-10-31)" section and the new template checklist lines; confirm no file outside the five listed was changed.
